name: peanut
description: A complete two-lobed peanut pod with two visible kernels.
useCase: Identify peanuts in ingredient lists, food menus or allergen information.
misuse: Pair this symbol with a clear label when its meaning depends on context.

16.reason: Two compact kernels sit inside the complete peanut shell with clear space around both lobes. The outline closes at its start without a short connecting stroke.

24.reason: The larger peanut keeps its full two-lobed pod, narrow waist and two visible kernels. The outline closes at its start without a short connecting stroke.
